Whether uninhabited systems draw their outline in the neutral color, or No color to hide them. Off (No color) by default - only faction-held, independent, and decivilised systems draw. Default: No color.
Political map outline opacity for uninhabited systems (drawn only when their border color is not No color). Default: 0.15.
Political map outline line width for uninhabited systems, in pixels. Default: 3.
Dev: corner-rounding radius of the national border, in world units. Higher rounds the cluster outline more; the cut self-limits on short edges. Default: 300.
Dev: arc segments per rounded corner of the national border. Higher is smoother but adds vertices. Default: 6.
Dev: corners sharper than this interior angle (degrees) are cut flat instead of rounded, removing thin spikes. Default: 35.

Dev: how far apart two outline points may be and still merge into one corner when chaining the border, in world units. Raise if faction borders go missing; too high merges distinct corners. Default: 50.

Dev: a corner whose inset point would jut past this multiple of the border inset is bevelled flat instead of pointed. Lower bevels sharp corners sooner (no inward spikes/loops); higher keeps crisper points. Default: 4.

Dev: a sharp corner rising less than this (world units) above its neighbours is a needle or cusp too thin for rounding to fix, so it is sanded off before rounding; a sharp corner that juts farther is kept as real shape. 0 disables spike sanding. Default: 150.

Dev: only corners sharper than this interior angle (degrees) are candidates for spike sanding; gentler corners and smooth arc facets are kept. Pairs with spike height - a corner must be both sharp and shallow to be sanded. 0 disables spike sanding. Default: 90.

column9: OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, ALL
column12: Verbosity of KMU's own output in starsector.log. WARN is the normal level; INFO adds routine lines and DEBUG adds per-frame overlay diagnostics. Default: WARN.
